warehouses.title: Warehouses

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who can sign in and what they can do.
users.name: Name
users.warehousesHint: Staff and managers work only in the warehouses ticked here.
users.resetDone: Password changed. Share it with {name} securely — they will choose a new one when they sign in.

roleHelp.ADMIN: Everything, including cost, settings and the audit log. Never needs approval.
roleHelp.STAFF: Records stock in, out and transfers in their warehouses; corrections and write-offs go for approval.
roleHelp.VIEWER: Can look at stock and history, can't change anything.
roleHelp.MANAGER: Records everything in their warehouses (incl. corrections, write-offs, voids) and approves requests there. No cost.
roleHelp.TECHNICIAN: Sees only the installation jobs issued to them.
roleHelp.ACCOUNTANT: Read-only, sees cost, stock value and the audit log.
